newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK new airport to pay HK$1.9bln in contract claims.
newsitem.headline: HK new airport to pay HK$1.9bln in contract claims.

text.p: Hong Kong's Airport Authority said on Friday it will pay a total of HK$1.9 billion to settle contractual claims up to mid-1996 but added the project was still within its budget of HK$49.8 billion.

"We have drawn on part of our contingency reserve to meet this new payment, and as a result remain prudently within our budget of HK$49.8 billion," Henry Townsend, chief executive of the authority, said in a statement.

The authority said it had reached two agreements with main contractors BCJ Joint Venture and AEH Joint Venture which would help to ensure that the new airport at Chek Lap Kok was completed on schedule in April 1998.
It said it agreed to pay BCJ, responsible for the terminal building, HK$1.5 billion to settle all contractural claims and to confirm the building was to be completed by October 1997.

The Airport Authority also said it had agreed to the value of final accounts with the Airport Platform Contractors Joint Venture which built the 1,248-hectart site for the new airport at a cost of HK$9.04 billion.
The cost for terminal foundations completed by the Gammon Nishimatsu Joint Venture was finalised at HK$465 million.
